user.title: Connect to your Philips TV
user.description: Enter the TV's IP address. The optional MAC address lets Home Assistant wake the TV with Wake-on-LAN.

pair.title: Enter the pairing PIN
pair.description: A PIN is showing on the TV screen. Type it here to finish pairing.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair with your Philips TV
reauth_confirm.description: A new PIN is showing on the TV screen. Type it here to restore access.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check that the TV is on and reachable at the given address.
error.invalid_pin: That PIN was not accepted. Check the TV screen and try again.
